Week of July 19

Filed under: #weekly

Hi. It's another week, so that means another week in review. Didn't forget to do it last minute this time, but that may just be because I've made even more progress on my website. I'm going to have to add my first real post to my website soon, because right now it has nothing.

My current plan is to put all my blogposts from here on my website, and after that I'll post my blog posts simultaneously on here and my website.

...I haven't been doing much besides sit on my computer and troubleshoot problems that probably shouldn't exist, but do anyway because I am not good at HTML or CSS etc. but I love doing it.

My sleep schedule has been really bad recently. Sleeping at 6 AM bad. And waking up at 2-3 PM. College is starting up again soon, so I can't afford to keep doing things like that. I'll have to get things in order.

Speaking of getting things in order, I have to clean my room. It's pretty messy right now. Honestly, that's my goal. My room has to be clean. Ah, my plushies probably feel like shit living in such a dirty room. I'm sorry.

Ellipsus has been slow for me (for some reason), so I'm currently writing on Obsidian, which is not a word processor. I have LibreOffice but I guess I just wanted to try writing on Obsidian. Since I'm going back to college, I thought I should get a good note-taking app along with it. However, I have heard many times (validated by my own experience) that writing things by hand is the best way to learn things.

I may just buy a bunch of notebooks, then, but that might take up a lot of space in my bag. Don't I need a new bag? My current backpack is falling apart! It's from the Philippines, and my aunt brought it over to me from there, so it's very special to me, but its life is almost over.

I have a lot of tote bags I could use in its stead, but they're either super ugly or so perfect I don't want to damage them even one bit or I'd cry.

P.S. did not finish my voicebank this week but I am getting closer and closer by the day. Watch out. I may end up shadowdropping them, because that would be really funny to me.

I guess we'll see. Eventually. And next week we'll see how things are going. With me. Okay. Bye.
